description: Get AIHOT's edited daily overview, either the latest issue or a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Use this when the user asks for a daily report rather than a raw chronological list.

date.description: Optional real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest daily report.

lang.description: Answer language: en gives the titles, summaries and digests in English where translated (the few not yet stay in Chinese), links to the English pages and English wording; zh (the default) answers in Chinese.

name: aihot_get_daily
